title: Dr.CPU+ Lacto Exosome Glutathione Capsule Cream
before_html:
A capsule-and-gel face cream from Dr.CPU+. This listing is for the yellow Glutathione formula.

What's included

  • Single (1 pc): One jar of the yellow Glutathione capsule-and-gel cream.
  • Two-pack (1+1): Two jars of the same yellow Glutathione formula.

Formula information

The supplied product information lists glutathione (500 ppm) and Lactobacillus extracellular vesicles (30,000 ppb).

How to use

Use the included spatula. Blend capsules and gel on your hand or face, spread evenly, and gently pat to finish.

  • Daily mix: capsules to gel 1:1
  • Richer-feeling mix: 2:1
  • Lighter-feeling mix: 1:2

Cautions

Stop use and consult a professional if irritation occurs. Do not use on damaged skin. Keep out of reach of children and store away from direct sunlight.

Frequently asked questions

Which formula is included?
The yellow Glutathione capsule-and-gel formula only.

Are the pink and green versions included?
No. Other formulas shown in range photographs are not included.
